metadata.title: On convex bodies with rotationally symmetric planar projections
metadata.abstract: Let $n\ge 3$ and let $K\subset\mathbb R^n$ be a convex body. For a two-dimensional linear subspace $P\subset\mathbb R^n$, let $K|P$ be the orthogonal projection of $K$ onto $P$. We prove that if for every two-dimensional subspace $P$, the planar convex body $K|P$ has $q$-fold rotational symmetry up to translation, then for $q\ge4$, this forces $K$ to be an Euclidean ball. The case $q=3$ is exceptional: non-spherical examples exist.

analysis.topic: 度量测度几何、极限与奇异空间
analysis.progressType: 平面投影旋转对称的刚性
analysis.workSummary: 若 n≥3 维凸体在每个二维子空间上的投影都平移后具有 q 重旋转对称，则 q≥4 强制凸体为欧氏球；q=3 存在非球例子。
analysis.breakthrough: 给出投影对称强制球性的阈值并分离三重对称例外。
analysis.limitations: 假设覆盖所有二维子空间，不能替换为有限方向。
analysis.priorityReason: 给出投影对称强制球性的阈值并分离三重对称例外。
